title: Apply both techniques.
lines: 1. Write a hyperbolic sentence about
Varjak’s panic when something scares him.
2. Write a power-of-three sentence
describing what Varjak sees, hears
or smells in the city.
Think about where in your narrative
these sentences might fit.
challenge: Write a single sentence that uses the power of three inside a hyperbolic idea.

q1: What is the difference between hyperbole and an ordinary description of fear?
q2: Why does the power of three feel more satisfying than a list of two or four?
q3: Which of your sentences today do you want to use in your final narrative?
